hero.descripcion: SolarisPKN-LiveTools is a long-term initiative: a unified ecosystem of tools, automations, and integrations built for streaming production. It starts with a first public module and keeps growing over time.

filosofia.label: Philosophy
filosofia.quote: Streaming platforms don't talk to each other — so we built the bridge.

items.label: Active module
items.texto: Syncs and migrates loyalty points between both platforms, so the community's history isn't lost when switching tools.

items.label: Architecture
items.texto: Each integration is an independent module — they're added one at a time, without depending on each other.

items.label: Growing
items.texto: This is the first released module of a larger suite, still under active development.

architecture.label: Architecture

items.name: StreamElements
items.desc: Overlay, alert, and loyalty-points platform for streamers.

items.name: Streamer.bot
items.desc: Local automation engine for streams — actions, triggers, and chat bots.

security.label: Security
items: Each module uses its own platform-specific credentials/API keys, without sharing secrets between integrations.
Designed to run locally or on your own infrastructure, not as a publicly exposed service.

cta.descripcion: This is just the first public module. The GitHub repository documents the current status and the full roadmap.
